findings.issue: Initial misdiagnosis of the sort-test failure as a stale served build; the 'Train' caption was actually correct for the wrongly-defaulted game selection
findings.suggestion: Verify the served asset hash matches the latest build before assuming staleness

findings.issue: Four turns debugging a TypeError in a throwaway probe script, then moving on without a root cause
findings.suggestion: For disposable scripts, rerun with minimal input first or drop the probe; don't chase it past one attempt

findings.issue: Large multi-file Python patch script failed entirely on a quoting syntax error (luckily a no-op)
findings.suggestion: Keep patch scripts to one file per call, or use simpler delimiters/triple-quoted strings from the start

findings.issue: Three calls to `npx @angular/cli version` (plus a cd typo) when the first output already contained the CLI version
findings.suggestion: Parse the first command's output before re-running it

findings.issue: Trace-zip inspection cost two failed attempts (missing unzip binary, broken heredoc) before the python zipfile fallback
findings.suggestion: Reach for `python3 -m zipfile` directly when unzip availability is unknown

summary: A disciplined, senior-engineer session: exhaustive spec/test/data reconnaissance before coding, data assumptions verified with probe scripts, and near-green first full test run. Both real failures were root-caused with genuine evidence — including parsing a Playwright trace.zip to find a test-helper timing quirk — rather than patched blindly. Verification went beyond the required tests (screenshots vs references, layout measurements, edge-case probes) and the full suite was re-run after the final change; the only deductions are ~9 avoidable shell/scripting slips scattered through an otherwise clean 90 turns.
